title: NormalizedRecord
description: The single versioned schema every parser normalizes tool output into. See recon_engine/schema.py. All fields must be non-null except vhost-only optional fields (status, length, title, redirect, baseline_diff).

schema_version.description: Versioned schema identifier. Must always be '1.0'.

observed_at.description: ISO8601 UTC timestamp (e.g. 2026-07-24T13:10:50Z). Must end with 'Z' for UTC.

target.description: Host or IP as seen in the raw artifact. Can be a hostname (target.invalid) or IP address (127.0.0.1, 192.168.1.1).

port.description: TCP/UDP port number. Must be in range 1-65535.

service.description: Service or protocol name (e.g. http, https, ssh, unknown). Never empty.

source_tool.description: The tool that discovered this record. Determines how to parse raw output.

source_file.description: Absolute or relative path to the raw artifact file this record was derived from (e.g. raw/fallback-socket-scanner/scan-1.txt).

notes.description: Additional context or observations about this record (e.g. 'banner: nginx/1.14', 'no banner', 'vhost differs from baseline').

status.description: HTTP status code (100-599), vhost-only field. Null if not applicable.

length.description: Response body length in bytes, vhost-only field. Null if not applicable.

title.description: HTTP page title extracted from <title> tag, vhost-only field. Null if not applicable.

redirect.description: HTTP redirect target (Location header), vhost-only field. Null if not applicable.

baseline_diff.description: Vhost-only field. Object containing differences between this response and the baseline (status, length, title, redirect, etc.). Null if candidate matches baseline.
